purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Mallowfen Glasswater Clause fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary pump-house work, the first glasswater root, competing containment and evidence actions, the assessor's arrival, the policy boundary, and four state-gated ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for establishing geometry, character routine, each choice threshold, the glasswater reveal, the assessor's arrival, the claim threshold, and each ending family. Selected branch actions use explicit additive modifiers on the relevant choice-result frame. The first luminous root and the cut governor seal each receive a focused visual beat.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt states visible geometry, materials, light, bodies, tools, and positions in plain language. Character refs are assembled only for visible named characters or groups. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink drawing with restrained watercolor, weathered fieldstone, worn brass, oak and wax, soft green dawn light against blue-white mana and eerie glass-green roots, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical magical machinery, unlettered surfaces.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every generation prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for characters or groups listed as visible in that scene, and all triggered state_image_modifiers and global_branch_image_modifiers. Each generation begins from this complete assembled text or a camera-specific scene-set input; generated images do not own room geometry.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture moves between one pump-house interior, its east delivery apron, two southern holding beds, and the adjacent first furrows. A draft plan fixes routes, camera slots, sightlines, and object states for review.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency illustrated website replay, build a simple plan view or 3D blockout of the Four-Course Pump House and adjacent apron, holding beds, first furrows, millcourse gate, and arrival path. Use camera-specific renders as geometry input for image generation.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide dawn establishing view of a low round fieldstone irrigation pump house built into a green canal bank in a high-fantasy farming village. A west arched doorway faces a muddy path. Through the open doorway, one brass-and-black-iron lifting engine stands on a central stone plinth, lit by a blue-white crystal cartridge. A grated spring intake descends on the south side. On the east wall, water crosses a carved stone delivery lip into a three-way splitter with low brass gate wheels. Outside the south door are two shallow empty stone holding beds and parallel barley furrows. A raised village cistern dome sits north of the building; a narrow millcourse runs east. Damp dawn light, reed mist, worn tools, and precise working geometry make the whole water route readable.
visual_continuity_notes: The pump house remains a compact round single-level room with west entry, south intake grate and field door, central engine plinth, east delivery lip and splitter, and north contract shelf.
The exterior water layout remains village cistern north, millcourse east, holding beds southeast, and Nine-Reed furrows south.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide interior at green dawn. Pella Reedbank, a short adult halfling woman with chestnut curls, moss-green wool vest, rolled cream linen sleeves, brown work trousers, muddy calf boots, brass keys, and a waxed tally board, stands on a fixed oak tread to read the high governor gauge. Senn Cloverrow, a broad middle-aged halfling man in a patched rust coat, straw field hat, muddy boots, and seed satchel, offers an oatcake beside the low south gate wheel. Dorrin Valevein, a compact dwarf journeyworker with a forked copper beard, soot-brown leather apron, dark wool work clothes, magnifying lens, and service satchel, inspects the red wax seal on the brass governor plate. The engine occupies the central plinth; the east delivery lip, south grate, low null chain, and north contract shelf are visible.

global_branch_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: Pella and Senn hold two stoppered sample bottles at spring grate and delivery lip; matching cartridge numbers are pressed into both wax collars on the low evidence shelf.
The north cistern gauge sits high and both shallow stone holding beds outside are raked clean with open drain stones and visible empty bottoms; the south furrow gate remains delayed.
Pella and Senn share the low south gate wheel; one torn oatcake rests on the stone apron while water reaches the first barley furrow on schedule.
Dorrin calls measures beside an intact red wax governor seal while Pella records them; a signed service line is clipped to the waxed tally board.
Pella pulls the low red-braided null chain; the black flywheel slows, blue-white rune channels dim from right to left, and the delivery stream thins to drops while eight furrows remain dry.
The south furrow gate is shut and suspect clear water spreads across two bare shallow stone holding beds under numbered stakes; the narrow east mill wheel slows.
Willow stakes mark a second measured wet row where fine glass-green root hairs appear behind the advancing water edge; Pella closes the gate at the final stake.
Two blue-white crystal cartridges rest in separate padded wooden boxes on the low shelf, each collar bearing distinct numbers and mixed fellowship-workshop custody wax.
Cal and Dorrin stand tightly beside the perfect gauge and clear delivery lip while Senn and the luminous root remain visually separated at the south doorway.

Pella leads Cal along one continuous visible route from spring grate to paired bottles, delivery lip, south doorway, willow stakes, and glass-green barley roots; Cal writes with the folio braced on one knee.
Pella pulls the iron bell rope above the west door; Nine-Reed farmers arrive in muddy work clothes with irrigation keys and individual tally slips, forming a witness line on the path and apron.
The red governor wax lies freshly cut; the brass plate stands open to show fine gold channels carrying faint glass-green after-lines downstream of the crystal socket.
Cal seals a thick joined packet containing paired samples, field stakes, crystal custody numbers, and one continuous route diagram; Pella holds a matching fellowship copy.
Cal closes a thin denial packet beside the perfect delivery gauge; the luminous root jar and field tally sit outside the folio on Pella's side of the low shelf.
The governor's red seal remains intact, the north cistern gauge is high, and water fills bare holding stone while the millcourse wheel stands still and the south barley gate stays shut.
The pump remains on its plinth beside a cut or disputed seal, a red low cistern gauge, and a Copper Mantle notice fastened to the west door; water routing looks materially insecure.

Nine-Reed households form a dense practical hauling line with full carts, barrels, yokes, livestock buckets, and ration marks; the cistern gauge remains above red and the miller contributes extra barrels.
Large gaps break the hauling line, several private-well paths turn away, the cistern gauge glows red, and Pella carries two buckets past empty cart ruts.
The two crystal lots, paired samples, exposed channels, copper test pattern, and test barrel form an orderly comparison; Cal's folio and a courier tube wait together at the delivery lip.
One crystal box lacks matching wax, sample bottles carry mismatched collars, the temporary copper pattern has several altered joints, and Cal closes the folio beside the cut seal.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for bodies listed as visible in a scene.

characters.pella_reedbank: Pella Reedbank: adult halfling woman, about three and a half feet tall, sturdy compact build, warm brown skin, round alert face, chestnut curls tied back with green cord, moss-green wool vest over rolled cream linen sleeves, brown work trousers, muddy calf boots, brass irrigation keys at belt, waxed tally board often under one arm; quick practical posture, reaches high governor gauge from a fixed oak tread.
characters.senn_cloverrow: Senn Cloverrow: middle-aged halfling man, broad compact build, weathered tan face, dark hair graying at the temples, patched rust-red field coat, straw hat with green binding, muddy short boots, canvas seed satchel, small curved field knife; generous food-sharing gestures and stubborn field-rooted stance.
characters.dorrin_valevein: Dorrin Valevein: adult dwarf journeyworker, compact square build, forked copper beard bound with two brass clips, soot-brown leather apron over charcoal wool work clothes, reinforced boots, magnifying lens, service satchel, stamped work gloves, small seal knife; precise posture close to gauges, bearings, crystal socket, and governor plate.
characters.caldris_morren: Caldris Morren: tall lean adult human man, close dark hair, narrow clean-shaven face, neat deep-blue travelling coat with a small brass bell badge at the collar, pale waistcoat, black riding boots, waxed leather claim folio and dark quill; careful contained posture, physically folds under the low pump-house lintel and narrows attention through paperwork.

groups.nine_reed_water_fellowship: Nine-Reed Water Fellowship households: halfling farm workers of varied ages and builds in patched wool vests, linen shirts, skirts or work trousers, muddy ankle or calf boots, straw hats and headscarves; each carries a practical item such as irrigation key, marked tally slip, small barrel, handcart, shoulder yoke, livestock bucket, or bundled infant; group posture ranges from a dense orderly hauling line to visibly missing households and turning paths.
